Here are some general prenatal care guidelines:

First trimester: Start taking prenatal vitamins, eat healthy, avoid alcohol/smoking/drugs, get plenty of rest. Get genetic screening. 

Second trimester: Get regular checkups to monitor baby's growth. Get tested for gestational diabetes. Get TDAP and flu vaccines. Look into birthing classes.

Third trimester: Monitor baby's movements. Pack a hospital bag. Take breastfeeding classes. Get any final checkups and tests. Get COVID vaccine if unvaccinated. Talk to doctor about labor plans.
